authors: N. Gromov, V. Kazakov, S. Leurent, D. Volin (QSC); nine-loop Konishi announced by D. Volin (talk, IGST 2013, Utrecht, 23 Aug 2013), quoted in Gromov-Levkovich-Maslyuk-Sizov-Valatka 1402.0871
title: Quantum spectral curve for AdS5/CFT4 (and the nine-loop Konishi anomalous dimension)
claim: The quantum spectral curve (P-mu system, a nonlinear matrix Riemann-Hilbert problem for a few Q-functions) reformulates the planar spectral problem; at weak coupling it gave the nine-loop Konishi anomalous dimension (stated in 1402.0871 with citation to a Volin talk), i.e. one of the 'nine-loop' claims in N=4 SYM.
loop_order: 9 (planar Konishi; first reported in a 2013 talk, later superseded by 10- and 11-loop QSC results, S1b.09, S1b.10)
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. Quantum spectral curve (P-mu system) with prescribed analyticity (short cuts at +-2g + i Z, power-like asymptotics).
symmetry_argument: integrability; psu(2,2|4) Q-system with analyticity constraints

assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit
QSC analyticity axioms (cut structure, asymptotics, regularity) characterize physical states
checked_partially: reproduces lower-order Konishi results (8 loops Y-system/FiNLIE)

evidence: 1402.0871 text (ar5iv): 'the new formulation also allowed to find the 9-loop Konishi anomalous dimension at weak coupling', citing [21]; 1405.4857 cites Volin's IGST 2013 talk (search snippet)
1305.1939 abstract (paraphrased): QSC as Riemann-Hilbert problem; weak-coupling applications
red_flags: first source of the nine-loop Konishi number is a conference talk, not a paper; published versions are the 10/11-loop QSC papers
no Feynman-graph or DR check exists beyond five loops (four loops by pure diagrams, five loops by correlator integrand + DR integrals)
source_access: abstract only (1305.1939) + full text via ar5iv (1402.0871 sentence); reference [21] entry not visible
